description: Cross-platform Electron launcher for RFP BidOS.
//packaging-todo: This config packages ONLY the launcher (main/status/assets). It is NOT a working distributable: main.js resolves appRoot to the repo parent and needs a sibling backend/.venv and frontend/node_modules at runtime, which are not bundled. A real distributable must (1) ship backend + frontend as extraResources, (2) detect app.isPackaged and resolve appRoot to process.resourcesPath instead of path.resolve(__dirname, '..'), and (3) bundle/point at a Python runtime and a built frontend. Until then, treat `npm run package` as dev-only.
